overview: The Medford School Committee met to review the FY22 budget timeline, receive reports on COVID-19 relief funding and fall 2021 listening sessions, and announce a upcoming public meeting on renaming the Columbus Elementary School. The committee also approved the superintendent's annual goals and resolutions regarding expedited educator vaccinations and postponed field trips.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Voted to enter executive session to discuss strategy regarding pending litigation before the Massachusetts Commission Against Discrimination.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Financial Reports
items.summary: Approved the January 25, 2021 meeting minutes as amended and noted regular review of bills and payroll.

items.title: School Committee Self-Evaluation Process
items.summary: Approved a motion to establish an annual self-evaluation and goal-setting process for the committee.

items.title: Reports of Committees
items.summary: Approved minutes from Committee of the Whole meetings on January 13 and January 25, the Communication Strategy subcommittee on February 2, and the special meeting on February 3.

items.title: Community Participation
items.summary: Received and paraphrased a public letter urging district preparations for a full return to in-person school in fall 2021.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent acknowledged the passing of IT technician Frank D'Alessio and reported on pooled COVID-19 testing, family meal assistance, and Black History Month events.

items.title: COVID-19 Health and Testing Update
items.summary: Staff reported Medford's transition to the yellow risk zone, shared initial operational results from pooled testing, and reviewed state vacation travel requirements.

items.title: Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility Report
items.summary: Advisors and students presented updates on district-wide CCSR service initiatives, including mask-making, a student podcast, and community gift bags.

items.title: Staff Recognitions and Equipment Donation
items.summary: Recognized librarians Maria Dorsey and Christina Johnson for state professional honors, and voted to accept the donation of a 2018 MacBook for student use.

items.title: FY22 Budget Overview and Timeline
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent David Murphy presented the FY22 budget development schedule and highlighted pressures including fixed costs and charter school tuition assessments.

items.title: Fall 2021 Reopening Listening Sessions
items.summary: Administrators presented a schedule of March listening sessions for students, staff, and families to gather feedback on hybrid and remote learning experiences.

items.title: Superintendent's Goals for 2020-2021
items.summary: Approved Superintendent Edouard-Vincent's performance goals for the 2020-2021 school year.

items.title: Columbus Elementary School Renaming Process
items.summary: Announced a Committee of the Whole meeting scheduled for March 10, 2021, and noted receipt of competing petitions and letters from community members regarding the school's name.

items.title: COVID-19 Relief Funding and Expenditures
items.summary: Reviewed expenditures of state and federal relief grants, which have predominantly supported instructional technology and ventilation improvements.

items.title: Resolution on Previously Approved Field Trips
items.summary: Approved a resolution allowing field trips postponed by the pandemic to be rescheduled within two years upon notification to the committee and approval by the superintendent.

items.title: MCAS Administration and Opt-Out Tracking
items.summary: Administrators addressed state directives requiring in-person MCAS testing without a remote option, and discussed district tracking procedures for families who opt out.

items.title: Resolution Supporting Expedited Vaccinations for Educators
items.summary: Approved a resolution urging state and federal officials and the Massachusetts Association of School Committees to prioritize educators for COVID-19 vaccination.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: Observed a moment of silence in memory of several community members and former school staff, including technology repair specialist Frank D'Alessio.
